parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top movable part of the dispenser, made of durable plastic and designed to be pressed by hand.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as the actuator that pushes down to dispense liquid from the container through the nozzle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head is the upper assembly that connects the pressing lid to the nozzle and internal pump mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the internal tube to the nozzle when the lid is pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but transfers pressure from the lid to the internal pump.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: The outlier is the small nozzle or spout through which the liquid exits the dispenser.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the flow of liquid outward in a controlled stream when the pump is activated.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed but allows liquid to pass through during operation.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main cylindrical container of the dispenser, made of plastic and designed to hold liquid soap or lotion.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid and supports the upper pump assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the structural base of the dispenser.
